task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, pick it up, then navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE and place the bottle there. The FRONT_CRATE obstacle is at (1.85, 1.50) which is near the MEDICINE_BOTTLE at (2.55, 1.5), but since CAR can navigate with tolerance, we proceed directly to pick up the bottle.
assumptions: CAR can navigate around obstacles using NavTo with appropriate tolerance
MEDICAL_TABLE is a valid placement location
CAR's interaction_distance of 2.0 is sufficient to interact with objects after navigation
rtdl: def task PlaceMedicineOnTable(;){ state nav_to_bottle_success: bool; state nav_to_bottle_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state nav_to_table_success: bool; state nav_to_table_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.55,y=1.5,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_bottle_success,message->nav_to_bottle_msg); check(nav_to_bottle_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="MEDICINE_BOTTLE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.3,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_table_success,message->nav_to_table_msg); check(nav_to_table_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="MEDICINE_BOTTLE",location_name="MEDICAL_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
